f94b99.title: Hardcoded secret in test file
f94b99.content: The string `wanderly_signing_secret_2026` was found in `src/lib/__tests__/scenario-travel.test.ts`. While it appears to be a test secret, hardcoding secrets in any part of the codebase, even tests, can be a security risk. It's recommended to use a proper secret management solution for all credentials, including test data.

b130e9.title: Potential XSS in LiveChatTab.tsx
b130e9.content: Semgrep detected a potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in `src/app/admin/_tabs/LiveChatTab.tsx` at line 599. User data is directly interpolated into HTML without proper sanitization. This could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the application, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or other client-side attacks.

73b000.title: Potential Path Traversal in system/setup/route.ts
73b000.content: Semgrep detected a potential Path Traversal vulnerability in `src/app/api/admin/system/setup/route.ts` at line 35. User input is used in `path.join` or `path.resolve` without proper sanitization, which could allow an attacker to access or manipulate arbitrary files on the system.

5f57b1.title: GCM Missing Authentication Tag Length in crypto.ts
5f57b1.content: Semgrep detected a cryptographic vulnerability in `src/lib/crypto.ts` at line 45. The `createDecipheriv` function, when used with GCM mode, is missing an expected authentication tag length. This could allow an attacker to spoof ciphertexts or recover the implicit authentication key of GCM, leading to data integrity and confidentiality issues.

97be9d.title: Dockerfiles allow root user
97be9d.content: Trivy FS detected a high-severity misconfiguration (DS-0002) in multiple Dockerfiles (`codebase-memory-mcp/pkg/glama/Dockerfile`, `codebase-memory-mcp/test-infrastructure/Dockerfile`, `codebase-memory-mcp/test-infrastructure/Dockerfile.alpine`, `codebase-memory-mcp/test-infrastructure/Dockerfile.lint`). These Dockerfiles do not specify a non-root user, which can lead to container escape situations if the container is compromised.

57dfaf.title: Dockerfile uses :latest tag
57dfaf.content: Trivy FS detected a medium-severity misconfiguration (DS-0001) in `codebase-memory-mcp/test-infrastructure/Dockerfile.mingw`. The Dockerfile uses the `:latest` tag for `mstorsjo/llvm-mingw`, which can lead to unpredictable builds and introduce vulnerabilities if the base image updates with breaking changes or security flaws.

2b7932.title: Multiple dependency CVEs found
2b7932.content: Trivy FS identified several CVEs in `npm` packages within `codebase-memory-mcp/graph-ui/package-lock.json`. These include vulnerabilities in `undici` and other dependencies. A full analysis of each CVE, including reachability and actual impact, would require further investigation. It is recommended to review and update these dependencies.
